How to find your daily calories & protein

Step 1 — Daily calories

Bodyweight (lbs) × 11–12 = daily calories for fat loss. 200 lbs × 12 = 2,400/day; 180 lbs × 11 = 1,980/day. Higher end if you are very active, lower end if sedentary. Track your weight 7–14 days; if it is not moving, drop 150–200 calories and reassess.

Step 2 — Protein goal

Bodyweight (lbs) × 0.8–1.0. At 180 lbs that is 145–180g/day; at 200 lbs, 160–200g/day. When in doubt, aim higher.

Step 3 — Get a digital food scale

Eyeballing food is the fastest way to stall progress. Weigh proteins, measure carbs and fats, and learn true portion sizes.

Step 4 — Track daily

Log meals, snacks, sauces and oils in MyFitnessPal, Cronometer or Lose It. Consistency beats perfection.

Birria Queso Protein Bowl

557cal
58gprotein
14gfat
46gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 64 oz Top sirloin steak, raw
  • 3 dried guajillo peppers
  • 100 g chipotle in adobo
  • 7 garlic cloves
  • 2 tsp cumin
  • 2 tsp smoked paprika
  • 2 tsp oregano
  • 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
  • 4 cups bone broth
  • 5 cups Minute Rice, dry
  • 1 tbsp tomato paste
  • 400 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 100 g reduced-fat cream cheese
  • 100 g Tostitos Salsa Con Queso
  • 200 g nonfat Greek yogurt
  • 1 tsp lime juice
  • Salt to taste
  • Black pepper to taste

Instructions

  1. Guajillo Prep: Deseed the guajillo peppers first, then drop them into a wide pot of boiling water and let them roll at a steady boil for 10–12 minutes until softened and the kitchen smells like dried pepper tea—rich, earthy, and warm. Drain, set aside to steam dry for a minute (no stacking them into a pile), then move them straight into the blender.
  2. Birria Sauce: Add the boiled guajillos, 50 g chipotle in adobo, 6 garlic cloves, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, splash apple cider vinegar, 2 bay leaves, and 1 cup of bone broth into a high-speed blender and run until the sauce turns into a spreadable, aerated red puree that looks whipped, not watery, carrying deep pepper sweetness with smoky chipotle heat.
  3. Beef Cook: Place the cubed top sirloin into the slow cooker, pour the birria sauce evenly over the surface, add 1 more cup bone broth in a wide pour, season aggressively with salt and cracked black pepper, then slow-cook on LOW for 6–8 hours until the beef shreds under the slightest pressure from a fork.
  4. Protein Queso Fold: Pre-blend cottage cheese, cream cheese, 1 garlic clove, and 100 g Tostitos Salsa Con Queso until ultra-smooth, then pour the blended queso across the shredded beef in the crockpot and fold in broad, outward mixing motions until fully incorporated into a creamy birria- queso beef.
  5. Spanish Rice: Pre-blend 50 g chipotle with 2 cups bone broth, whisk in tomato paste and salt, scatter rice flat like a wide rice-sheet on the surface, then simmer until absorbed and fluffy. Assemble Bowls: Spoon rice into bowls first, layer with the creamy queso-folded birria beef, then finish with optional yogurt, lime, or cracked black pepper. Optional: Add some fresh avocado, and cojita cheese. adjust macros accordingly and ENJOY

Philly Steak and Rice Bowls

557cal
60gprotein
13gfat
49gcarbs
from the book

8 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 3.5 lb top sirloin steak, trimmed and cut into large chunks
  • 1½ cups beef bone broth
  • 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
  • 2 tbsp low-calorie soy sauce
  • 1 medium green bell pepper, sliced
  • 1 medium red bell pepper, sliced
  • ½ cup white onion, chopped
  • 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 2 tsp ranch powder
  • Salt & pepper to taste Rice
  • 4 cups dry instant white rice (Minute Rice)
  • Cheese Sauce (Blend Separately)
  • 200 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 62 g Rico’s cheese sauce
  • 1 packet Kraft mac & cheese powder
  • 120 g ⅓-less-fat cream cheese
  • ½ cup hot water or broth (plus more as needed) Finish
  • 200 g reduced-fat mozzarella, shredded

Instructions

  1. Spray slow cooker with nonstick spray. Add 3.5 lb sirloin, 1½ cups beef broth, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp soy sauce, bell peppers, onion, garlic, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp ranch powder, and salt & pepper to taste.
  2. Cover and cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours, until steak shreds easily. Shred directly in the slow cooker and mix with juices and veggies.
  3. While steak finishes, cook 4 cups dry instant rice according to package directions using water or broth. Fluff and set aside.
  4. In a blender, combine 200 g cottage cheese, 62 g Rico’s cheese sauce, 1 packet mac & cheese powder, 120 g reduced-fat cream cheese, and ½ cup hot water or broth. Blend until smooth and pourable, adding liquid 1 tbsp at a time if needed.
  5. In the last 5 minutes of slow cooking, sprinkle 200 g reduced-fat mozzarella evenly over the steak mixture. Cover until melted.
  6. To serve, portion ⅛ of the rice into each bowl, top with ⅛ of the steak & veggie mixture, and drizzle with cheese sauce just before serving.
  7. ⭐ Meal-Prep Notes 1. • Stores 2-3 days refrigerated 2. • Reheats best with a splash of broth 3. • Optional add-ons: mushrooms, banana peppers, hot sauce

Queso Chicken & Rice Bowls

579cal
60gprotein
12gfat
55gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • Chicken breast, raw, skinless – 4 lb
  • Fat-free cottage cheese – 600g
  • ⅓-reduced-fat cream cheese – 120g
  • Reduced-fat cheddar cheese – 200g
  • Rico’s cheese sauce – 120g
  • Kraft mac & cheese powder – 72g
  • Mild taco seasoning – 1 oz (~2 Tbsp)
  • Chipotle peppers in adobo – ½ cup
  • (~120 g)
  • Chicken broth – ½ cup (~120 ml)
  • Minute white rice (dry) – 520 g (~2¾ cups)
  • Fresh cilantro, chopped – 1 cup (~16 g)
  • Lime, juice + zest – 1 lime (~2 Tbsp juice + zest)

Instructions

  1. Season & Add Chicken Place 4 lb chicken breast into the slow cooker. Sprinkle evenly with 1 oz taco seasoning and pour in ½ cup chicken broth.
  2. Slow Cook Cover and cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours, until the chicken is tender and easily shreddable.
  3. Blend the Queso Sauce In a blender, combine 600 g cottage cheese, 120 g cream cheese, 120 g cheese sauce, 72 g mac & cheese powder, and ½ cup chipotle peppers. Blend until smooth.
  4. Shred & Add Sauce (Final 30 Minutes) Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker. Pour in the blended queso sauce, stir well, cover, and cook on LOW for 30 minutes.
  5. Melt the Cheese Stir in 200 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese until fully melted and creamy.
  6. Prepare Rice & Assemble Cook 520 g Minute rice according to package directions. Stir in 1 cup chopped cilantro and juice + zest of 1 lime. Divide rice and queso chicken into 10 servings.

Chipotle Queso Steak & Rice Bowls

565cal
54gprotein
18gfat
48gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4.25 lb flank steak
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tbsp salt & pepper
  • 1 tsp cumin
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • ½ cup chipotle peppers in adobo
  • ½ cup ROTEL tomatoes & chiles
  • ½ cup beef bone broth
  • 650 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 200 g ⅓-less-fat cream cheese
  • 1 packet Kraft mac & cheese powder
  • ¼ cup chipotle peppers in adobo
  • 2–3 tbsp beef bone broth (to loosen)
  • 450 g instant white rice (dry, ≈9 cups cooked)
  • Reduced-fat shredded cheddar cheese
  • (to top)

Instructions

  1. Add 4.25 lb flank steak, garlic powder, onion powder, salt & pepper, cumin, chili powder, ½ cup chipotle peppers, ½ cup ROTEL, and ½ cup bone broth to the slow cooker. Stir to coat steak evenly.
  2. Cook HIGH 4 hours or LOW 7 hours, until steak is tender and easily shreds.
  3. In a blender, combine 650 g cottage cheese, 200 g reduced-fat cream cheese, Kraft cheese powder, ¼ cup chipotle peppers, and 2–3 tbsp bone broth. Blend until silky smooth.
  4. Cook 450 g dry rice according to package directions (yields ~9 cups cooked). Set aside. (i use minute rice to save time)
  5. With 20 minutes left, shred steak in the slow cooker, stir in all cooked rice, then pour in the blended chipotle queso sauce. Mix thoroughly.
  6. Top with reduced-fat shredded cheddar, switch heat to LOW, cover, and let melt for 20 minutes until creamy and fully combined. Portion into 10 servings. equally distribute rice

Cheddar Chicken Broccoli & Rice

571cal
62gprotein
11gfat
49gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4 lb raw, skinless chicken breast
  • 1 cup chicken bone broth
  • 1 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tbsp garlic salt
  • 2 tbsp ranch seasoning
  • 1 tbsp herbs & garlic seasoning
  • 1 tsp salt
  • ½ tsp black pepper
  • Minute Rice (enough dry rice to yield 5 cups cooked)
  • 800 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 120 g ⅓-less-fat cream cheese
  • 120 g premium cheddar cheese
  • 2 packets Kraft mac & cheese powder
  • 200 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar
  • 2 cups broccoli florets

Instructions

  1. Add 4 lb chicken breast to the slow cooker. Season with 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp garlic salt, 2 tbsp ranch seasoning, 1 tbsp herbs & garlic seasoning, 1 tsp salt, and ½ tsp black pepper. Pour in 1 cup chicken bone broth.
  2. Cover and cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours, until chicken is tender. Shred directly in the slow cooker.
  3. In a blender, combine 800 g fat-free cottage cheese, 120 g reduced-fat cream cheese, 120g cheddar, and 2 packets mac & cheese powder. Blend until smooth and creamy.
  4. Prepare Minute Rice separately, cooking enough dry rice to yield 5 cups cooked. Set aside.
  5. During the last 30 minutes of slow cooking, pour in the blended cheese sauce. Add 200 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar and 2 cups broccoli florets. Stir well until melted and broccoli is tender.
  6. Just before serving, fold in the 5 cups cooked rice. Mix until evenly combined and creamy.
  7. ⭐ Meal-Prep Notes • Stores 2-3 days refrigerated or freeze • Reheats best with a splash of water or broth • Great base for hot sauce, buffalo, or sriracha drizzle

Mongolian Beef & Rice

552cal
51gprotein
16gfat
46gcarbs
from the book

9 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • Beef & Sauce (Slow Cooker)
  • 4 lb top round beef, thinly sliced against the grain
  • 1 cup beef bone broth
  • 1 cup premium light soy sauce
  • 2 tbsp hoisin sauce
  • 2 tbsp sriracha sauce
  • 4 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 2 stevia packets (or 1 tbsp brown sugar equivalent)
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 red bell pepper, sliced
  • 2 whole jalapeños, sliced (optional)
  • Thickener (Added Last Hour)
  • 2 tbsp cornstarch
  • 2–3 tbsp broth (for slurry)
  • Rice (Cook Separately)
  • 400g Minute white rice (dry, cooked per package directions)
  • Garnish (Optional)
  • Green onions
  • Sesame seeds

Instructions

  1. (Optional but recommended) Lightly spray a skillet and sear sliced beef 2–3 minutes per side to lock in flavor.
  2. Add beef to the slow cooker along with 1 cup bone broth, 1 cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp sriracha, 4 tbsp rice vinegar, garlic, bell pepper, jalapeños, and stevia. Stir to coat evenly.
  3. Cover and cook on LOW 6 hours.
  4. in the final hour, whisk 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2–3 tbsp broth until smooth. Stir into the slow cooker, switch to HIGH, and cook 1 additional hour until sauce thickens.
  5. While sauce thickens, cook 400 g Minute rice according to package directions.
  6. Portion 1/9 of the rice into each container, top with 1/9 of the Mongolian beef, and garnish with green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
  7. ⭐ Meal-Prep Notes 1.• Stores 4–5 days refrigerated 2.• Sauce thickens more as it cools 3.• Swap rice for cauliflower rice for lower carbs

Creamy Tuscan Chicken & Rice

583cal
64gprotein
15gfat
41gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4 lb raw, skinless chicken breast
  • 400 g Minute white rice (≈ 2½ cups dry)
  • 550 g fat-free cottage cheese (≈ 2 cups)
  • 150 g ⅓-fat cream cheese (≈ ¾ cup)
  • ½ cup chicken bone broth (¼ cup for chicken + ¼ cup for sauce)
  • 2 tsp Italian seasoning (1 tsp for chicken + 1 tsp for sauce)
  • 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice
  • 60 g sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
  • 3–4 cups fresh spinach
  • 100 g shredded parmesan cheese
  • 150 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese
  • 150 g reduced-fat mozzarella cheese
  • ½ cup fresh basil, chopped
  • 1–2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • Salt & black pepper to taste
  • Optional: pinch paprika or red pepper flakes

Instructions

  1. Add 4 lb chicken breast to the slow cooker. Season with 1–2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Pour ¼ cup bone broth over the top.
  2. Cover and cook on HIGH for 4 hours (or LOW 6–7 hours) until chicken is tender and shreddable.
  3. In a blender, combine 550 g cottage cheese, 150 g cream cheese, ¼ cup bone broth, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, and 1 tbsp lemon juice. Blend until completely smooth.
  4. With 1 hour remaining, add 60 g sun-dried tomatoes and 3–4 cups spinach directly to the slow cooker. Let wilt.
  5. Shred the chicken in the crockpot. Pour in the blended sauce, then add ½ cup basil, 100 g parmesan, 150 g cheddar, and 150 g mozzarella. Cover and cook 20–30 minutes until creamy and thick.
  6. Cook 400 g Minute rice separately per package directions. Fold cooked rice into the crockpot until fully coated. Portion into 10 containers.

Pizza Pocket Burritos

390cal
42gprotein
14gfat
18gcarbs
from the book

12 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 3 lb (1360 g) raw, skinless chicken breast
  • 1½ cups (360 ml) pizza sauce
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tbsp Italian seasoning
  • 1 tsp dried basil
  • 120 g (4 oz) ⅓-reduced-fat cream cheese
  • 200 g reduced-fat mozzarella, shredded
  • 100 g turkey pepperoni
  • 12 Carb Balance Burrito Tortillas
  • 12 thin provolone slices (≈10 g each)
  • ½ tsp salt
  • ½ tsp black pepper

Instructions

  1. Season + Sauce → Place 3 lb (1360 g) chicken flat in the crockpot. Sprinkle 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp basil, 2 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp salt, and ½ tsp pepper evenly across the top of the chicken. Pour 1½ cups (360 ml) pizza sauce over the surface to cover the chicken.
  2. Slow Cook → Cover and cook on LOW (≈190°F / 88°C) for 5–6 hours until the chicken shreds easily. If it doesn’t, add +30 minutes.
  3. Shred + Mix Cream Cheese → Shred chicken in the pot. Add 120 g cream cheese and stir until mixed in (≈90 seconds to fully combine). Pepperoni + Mozz Melt → Add 100 g turkey pepperoni and 200 g mozzarella on top, cover, and cook 20 more minutes until fully melted.
  4. Final Mix → Stir everything together until creamy (30–45 seconds). Portion + Wrap → Add ~140 g cheesy pizza chicken per tortilla. Add 1 provolone slice (≈10 g) per tortilla. Fold burrito-style and air fry at 375°F (190°C) for 6 minutes, flipping halfway (or pan-toast 3 minutes per side).

Chicken Verde Nacho Burritos

465cal
60gprotein
19gfat
37gcarbs
from the book

11 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 11 Mission Carb Balance flour tortillas
  • 4 lbs raw, skinless chicken breast
  • 1 cup (240 g) salsa verde
  • 1 cup (240 ml) chicken bone broth
  • ½ cup taco seasoning
  • 250 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese
  • 100 g reduced-fat mozzarella cheese
  • 100 g queso blanco
  • 200 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 75 g reduced-fat cream cheese
  • ½ cup green chilis (canned)

Instructions

  1. Add 4 lb chicken breast, 1 cup salsa verde, 1 cup chicken broth, and ¼ cup taco seasoning to the slow cooker and add the ½ cup green chilis for extra heat. Stir lightly to coat chicken.
  2. Cover and cook on LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours, until chicken shreds easily.
  3. Shred chicken directly in the slow cooker using two forks and mix into the cooking liquid.
  4. In a blender, combine 200 g cottage cheese, 75 g cream cheese, 250 g reduced-fat cheddar, 100 g mozzarella, and 100g queso blanco. Blend until smooth, adding 2–4 tbsp slow-cooker liquid if needed.
  5. Pour cheese sauce into shredded chicken. Stir well, cover, and let sit on WARM 10–15 minutes until fully melted and creamy.
  6. Lay out 11 tortillas and fill each with about 1 cup chicken nacho mixture. Roll into burritos. Optional: crisp in a skillet with light oil spray 1–2 minutes per side.
  7. Allow to cool down for 20-30 mins then roll up in tin foil or meal container and refrgierate for 2-3 days or freeze for up to 30 days.

Slow Cooked Breakfast Burritos

469cal
42gprotein
25gfat

from the book

11 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 10 Kirkland chicken sausage links (finely chopped or food-processed)
  • 8 whole eggs
  • 400 g liquid egg whites
  • 10 slices center-cut bacon, cooked & chopped
  • 510 g frozen Potatoes O’Brien
  • 300g reduced-fat cheddar cheese
  • 11 Mission Carb Balance flour tortillas
  • Taco seasoning (to taste, ~1–1½ tbsp total)
  • Nonstick spray or 1 tsp oil

Instructions

  1. Spray the slow cooker with nonstick spray. Add 510 g frozen Potatoes O’Brien directly to the bottom and spread evenly.
  2. Finely chop or food-process 10 chicken sausage links. Sauté in a skillet over medium heat with ½–1 tbsp taco seasoning and a light spray of oil for 4–5 minutes until heated through. Add sausage on top of the potatoes.
  3. In a bowl, whisk 8 whole eggs with 400 g egg whites and ½ tbsp taco seasoning. Pour evenly over the potato-sausage mixture.
  4. Cover and cook on HIGH 2–3 hours, until eggs are fully set.
  5. During the last 30 minutes, sprinkle in 300 g reduced-fat cheddar and fold in 10 slices cooked, chopped center-cut bacon. Cover and let melt.
  6. Spoon mixture evenly into 11 tortillas, roll into burritos, and serve or wrap for meal prep.
  7. ⭐
  8. Meal-Prep Notes 2.• Stores 2-3 days refrigerated 3.• Freezes well up to 2 months 4.• Reheat in air fryer or skillet for best texture

Ingredients

Chicken Parmesan Alfredo

540cal
65gprotein
11gfat
40gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast
  • 2 cups bone broth (Kettle & Fire or similar)
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tbsp Italian seasoning
  • Salt & pepper, to taste
  • 80g shredded Parmesan cheese, divided
  • 100g ⅓-reduced-fat cream cheese
  • 600g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 1 tbsp lemon juice
  • 100g reduced-fat mozzarella cheese
  • 18 oz Barilla Protein+ angel hair pasta

Instructions

  1. Spray slow cooker. Add 4 lb chicken breast, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, plus salt & pepper to taste.
  2. Pour in 2 cups bone broth and add 40g Parmesan. Cover and cook LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3–4 hours, until chicken shreds easily.
  3. In a blender, combine 600g fat-free cottage cheese, 100g reduced-fat cream cheese, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and remaining 40g Parmesan. Blend until completely smooth.
  4. Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker, then pour in the blended sauce and stir until creamy and fully coated.
  5. Cook 18 oz Barilla Protein+ angel hair pasta according to package directions, drain, and stir into the slow cooker.
  6. Add 100g reduced-fat mozzarella, stir until melted and creamy, then portion into 10 equal servings and serve hot.

Ingredients

  • 4 lb raw, skinless chicken breast

  • 800 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 200 g ⅓-less-fat cream cheese
  • 200 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese
  • 200 g regular cheddar cheese
  • 2 packets Kraft mac & cheese powder

  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 tsp salt
  • ½ tsp black pepper
  • (adjust seasonings for your preference)

Instructions

  1. Slow Cooker Base Add 4 lb chicken breasts, 2 cups chicken broth, and ½ cup buffalo sauce to the slow cooker. Season with 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt, and ½ tsp black pepper.
  2. Cook the Chicken Cover and cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours, until chicken shreds easily with forks.
  3. Cook the Pasta While chicken cooks, boil 16 oz protein cavatappi pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
  4. Make the Cheese Sauce In a blender, combine: 800 g fat-free cottage cheese 200 g ⅓-less-fat cream cheese 200 g reduced-fat cheddar 200 g regular cheddar 2 packets mac & cheese powder Blend until completely smooth. Add 2–4 tbsp chicken broth if needed to thin.

Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta

75gprotein

adjusted for protein pasta

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4 lb raw, skinless chicken breast
  • 2 cups low-sodium chicken bone broth
  • (plus up to ½ cup extra if needed)
  • 1 lb (16 oz) protein cavatappi pasta (Banza or similar)
  • 8 slices uncured center-cut bacon
  • 700 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 200 g ⅓-less-fat cream cheese
  • 200 g reduced-fat mozzarella (added at end)
  • 100 g shredded Parmesan
  • 3 tsp ranch seasoning mix (plus 1 tsp extra for sauce)
  • 1 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder

  • 1 cup chopped kale (optional)

Instructions

Creamy Chicken Tortellini

525cal
60gprotein
18gfat
28gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4 lb raw, skinless chicken breast
  • 4 cups cheese tortellini (Rana Cheese Lovers; use a high-protein version if you can find one)
  • 2 cups Rao’s Homemade Marinara
  • 100 g ⅓-reduced-fat cream cheese
  • 350 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 100 g shredded parmesan cheese
  • 100 g reduced-fat mozzarella cheese
  • 3 garlic cloves, minced
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 tbsp Italian seasoning
  • Salt & pepper to taste

Instructions

  1. Lightly spray the slow cooker. Add 4 lb chicken breast to the bottom and season evenly with 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, 3 minced garlic cloves, salt, and pepper.
  2. Pour 2 cups Rao’s Homemade Marinara directly over the seasoned chicken, ensuring it’s evenly coated.
  3. Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours (or HIGH for 3–4 hours) until the chicken is tender and easily shreddable.
  4. In a blender, combine 350 g fat-free cottage cheese and 100 g reduced-fat cream cheese. Blend until completely smooth and creamy.
  5. Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker. Pour in the blended sauce, then stir in 100 g parmesan, 100 g reduced-fat mozzarella, and 4 cups Rana tortellini until fully coated.
  6. Cover and cook on LOW for 20 minutes, until the tortellini is tender and the sauce thickens. Taste, adjust seasoning if needed, and portion into 10 high-protein servings.

Queso Taco Mac N Cheese

579cal
65gprotein
16gfat
45gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4 lb 96/4 lean ground beef
  • 18 oz Barilla Protein+ Cellentani pasta
  • 900 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 150 g ⅓-reduced-fat cream cheese
  • 120 g Rico’s Premium Cheddar Cheese Sauce
  • 200 g reduced-fat shredded cheese
  • 1 red bell pepper, finely chopped
  • 4 tbsp Siete mild taco seasoning
  • ½ cup beef bone broth
  • ½ cup hot sauce or taco sauce (to taste)
  • 1 Kraft Mac & Cheese cheese powder packet

Instructions

  1. Hit slow cooker with olive oil spray and then add 4lbs of 96/4 beef (optional break up the beef and brown first) to slow cooker.
  2. Add 4 tbsp taco seasoning, ½ cup beef bone broth, and ½ cup hot/taco sauce to the slow cooker. Stir well. Cook HIGH 3–4 hours or LOW 6–7 hours.
  3. In a blender, combine 900 g fat-free cottage cheese, 150 g reduced-fat cream cheese, 120 g Rico’s cheddar cheese sauce, and 1 Kraft cheese powder packet. Blend until completely smooth.
  4. With 30 minutes left on LOW, pour the blended queso sauce into the slow cooker along with 200 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar and 1 chopped red bell pepper. Stir to combine.
  5. While queso finishes, cook 18 oz Protein+ pasta according to package directions. Drain well.
  6. Fold cooked pasta into the slow cooker, stir until fully coated and creamy, then portion into 10 servings.

Queso Steak Macaroni & Cheese

548cal
52gprotein
19gfat
44gcarbs
from the book

8 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 2.25 lb flank steak
  • 16 oz Banza shells (uncooked)
  • 600 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 100 g Rico’s Premium Cheddar Cheese Sauce
  • 100 g ⅓-reduced-fat cream cheese
  • 120 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar
  • (added at the end)
  • 40 g chipotle peppers in adobo
  • ½ cup beef bone broth
  • 1 tsp ancho chili powder
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp black pepper

Instructions

  1. Add 2.25 lb flank steak to the slow cooker. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, and ancho chili powder. Add 40 g chipotle peppers on top and pour in ½ cup bone broth.
  2. Cook HIGH 3.5–4 hours or LOW 7–8 hours, until steak is tender and shreddable.
  3. Shred steak directly in the slow cooker and mix into the chipotle broth.
  4. In a blender, combine 600 g fat-free cottage cheese, 100 g Rico’s cheddar sauce, and 100 g reduced-fat cream cheese. Blend until ultra-smooth, then pour over the shredded steak. Warm on LOW 10–15 minutes.
  5. Cook 16 oz Banza shells according to package directions. Drain well.
  6. Stir cooked pasta into the slow cooker, then add 120 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar. Mix until melted, creamy, and fully coated. Divide into 8 servings.

Creamy Tuscan Steak & Pasta

585cal
55gprotein
18gfat
41gcarbs
from the book

10 servings, Prep Time: 20-30 minutes | Cook Time: 6-7 hours

Ingredients

  • 4 lb top round steak, trimmed
  • 2 cups chicken bone broth
  • 1 tbsp Italian seasoning
  • 1 tsp basil seasoning
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp black pepper
  • 1,000 g fat-free cottage cheese
  • 250 g whole-milk ricotta
  • 2 tbsp tomato paste
  • ½ tsp garlic powder
  • ½ tsp Italian seasoning
  • Salt & pepper, to taste
  • 60 g sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
  • 1 cup fresh spinach, chopped
  • 100 g reduced-fat mozzarella, shredded
  • 20 oz Barilla Protein+ pasta, cooked separately

Instructions

  1. Add 4 lb top round steak, 2 cups bone broth, Italian seasoning, basil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the slow cooker. (use olive oil spray first)
  2. Cook LOW 6–7 hours or HIGH 3.5–4 hours, until steak is fork-tender.
  3. Shred steak directly in the slow cooker using two forks.
  4. In a blender, combine 1,000g fat free cottage cheese, 250g ricotta, 2tbsp tomato paste, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, and salt & pepper. Blend until smooth.
  5. Stir blended sauce into shredded steak, then add sun-dried tomatoes and spinach. Cover and cook LOW 30 minutes.
  6. Turn heat off, stir in 100 g mozzarella until melted, then fold in cooked Protein+ pasta or portion pasta separately.
